senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; רמם , v. רִמָּה) [crowded with seeds, cmp. רָחַשׁ,] pomegranate.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4:8">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite> <he>כר׳ הזה</he>, v. <cite ref="T00706"><he>רֵיקָן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:2:1">ib. to VIII, 2</cite> (ref. to <he>עסיס רמני</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:2:1">Ib.</cite>) <he>אלו ההגדות שטעמן כר׳</he> that means the homiletic interpretations whose taste is like that of the pomegranate; a. fr.—Pl. <he>רִמּוֹנִים</he>, <he>רִמּוֹנִין</he>.
